findings.text: 有多步骤编码或需要多个专家的 DSH 用户；基线是单代理加人工任务管理。[Q01](#research-q01)
以任务与源码版本等生成成员 brief 绑定，返回时校验身份、结果状态并标记自报用量。[Q02](#research-q02)
固定 inventory 165 文件、49 排除、零解析错误；静态核查关键委派、审批和存储路径。
根 npm 包为 DSH 插件与可选 MCP 连接提供入口。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 宿主与模型 | 配置角色和任务 | 兼容需验证 |
| 持续 | 多模型调用 | 独立审查 | 自报预算非账单 |
| 恢复 | 重新执行可能计费 | 恢复持久任务 | flush 失败抛错 |
隔离试用、限定分工并独立检查 diff 和测试；审批或版本异常即停止。[Q04](#research-q04)

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 委派 | 绑定及结果身份校验 | 代码正确性 |
| 删除保护 | 匹配 strict 命令时审批 | 所有删除路径覆盖 |
成员结果绑定任务与源码版本；自报成本不构成硬预算，严格保护只拦截匹配命令。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)
把任务记忆、专家分工与版本绑定结果组织进编码流程。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02)
reviewable 不证明代码正确或硬预算受控，严格删除保护也仅覆盖识别的工具命令。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)
未验证假设：成员自报与独立验证结果并列可降低误接收，须对照现有 binding 和 checks 字段。[Q05](#research-q05)

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DSH 与任务服务 | 必需 | 任务和预设 | 回单代理 |
| 子代理与模型 | 委派需要 | 成员执行 | 人工处理 |
| 宿主持久化 | 任务持久化需要 | 保存记忆 | 抛错 |
| 审批服务 | 严格删除需要 | 单次确认 | 拒绝命令 |

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) novelty：版本绑定及委派属于已有模式取小幅；mechanism：task/requirements/source 摘要与结果校验组合取实质；transferability：依赖宿主但 binding 思路可借鉴取实质；simplification：结构化交付仍需独立审查取实质以下。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) workflow：任务、专家和记忆衔接取实质；delivery：[Q03](#research-q03) 接入宿主与审批但覆盖受限取实质；reach：[Q04](#research-q04) 面向 DSH 编码团队取实质；economics：无本轮评测与账单对照未知。

recommendation.reason: 需要将复杂编码任务拆给多个专家的 DSH 用户可先在隔离仓库试用。相比单代理，它提供版本绑定的任务报告，但自报检查和成本仍须独立核验。若任务版本不匹配、审批不可用或结果未验证，应停止合入并回到人工审查。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 多步骤编码、用户和单代理基线明确达到一半；实际频率未测不足更高档。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 任务版本绑定和结构化报告超过普通分派达到一半；正确率与效率未对照不足更高档。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) 源码覆盖身份、成本和审批分支，比仅文档更强；未运行宿主不足更高档。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 隔离任务可停止高于零；多模型、审批和人工核验成本不足一半。

查看原文（10行） ```text ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | |---|---| | 批量工具调用 | 在一次模型调用中并行读取多个文件，减少往返次数 | | 分层记忆 | 当前任务、项目经验和全局偏好分别存储，每条记录均标注来源 | | 运行预算 | 默认使用效果更好的旧压缩预算，可在设置中调整 | | 删除保护 | 默认引导 Agent 使用可恢复的 `trash`，可切换为严格确认 | | MCP 连接 | 允许外部 MCP 客户端将任务委派给 DSH 执行，默认关闭 | | 前端 Skill | 开发页面时按需加载，检查对齐、点击区域和浏览器表现 | ```
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:96-103](https://github.com/ArtlexYoung/dsh-super-code/blob/c9d50912df1e6624543481cb0d724ff3e18ef509/README.md#L96-L103) 作者描述评测方法。 ```text ## 评测 ### 评测方法 - **题集**：SWE-bench Pro hard-100，使用官方评分器。调优仅使用 SWE-bench dev 中筛选的 33 道困难题；hard-100 只用于评测冻结后的候选版本和排查问题，不参与调优，以避免对评测题过拟合。 - **对照**：官方标准预设，而非 minimal。旧宿主实测中，标准 + high 通过 51 题，minimal + high 通过 46 题，且标准每题 token 少 23.5%。与更强的对照比较，结论更严格。 - **控制变量**：同一宿主、同一模型、同一思考等级、同一预算，仅替换 Agent 预设。 - **指标**：通过数、每题净耗时（扣除失败请求和重试等待）、每题 token、每题模型调用次数。 ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/core/delegation.ts:5-17](https://github.com/ArtlexYoung/dsh-super-code/blob/c9d50912df1e6624543481cb0d724ff3e18ef509/src/core/delegation.ts#L5-L17) 委派输入和结果结构。
查看原文（13行） ```text export interface MemberAssignment { owner: string; attemptId: string; objective: string; ownedPaths: string[]; acceptance: string[]; maxTokens: number } export interface MemberBrief extends MemberAssignment { binding: string; sessionId: string; taskId: string; createdAtSeq: number; requirementsRevision: number; delegationRevision: number workspace: string; sourceVersion: string; constraints: string[]; taskGoal: string; taskAcceptance: string[] } export interface MemberResult { binding: string; owner: string; attemptId: string outcome: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled' | 'stop_unknown' summary: string; artifacts: string[]; checks: string[]; unknowns: string[] /** Optional self-report, never authenticated usage or budget enforcement. */ cost?: { inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; cachedTokens: number; toolCalls: number; complete: boolean } ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行 DSH、模型、MCP 或基准测试 **影响**：不能确认效率、权限覆盖和实际账单 **进一步探讨**：固定宿主与任务，在隔离工作区验证委派、恢复及审批 ### Q02 · 成员任务如何绑定，返回可审查是否意味着正确？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 只有 active 任务可生成 brief，摘要覆盖任务、需求和委派版本、源版本、工作区与分工；返回时重算绑定、比对 owner/attempt 与 completed 状态。reviewable 只表示这些前提满足，不验证实际改动、测试或路径归属。成员自报 cost 被标记 model-reported，预算仍为 unknown。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/core/delegation.ts:27-35](https://github.com/ArtlexYoung/dsh-super-code/blob/c9d50912df1e6624543481cb0d724ff3e18ef509/src/core/delegation.ts#L27-L35) active 校验和摘要绑定。 ```text /** Compact, version-bound inputs for the existing host subagent provider. */ export function createMemberBrief(task: TaskMemory, sessionId: string, input: MemberAssignment): MemberBrief { const assignment = assignmentSchema.parse(input) if (sessionId.trim() === '') throw new Error('sessionId is required') if (task.status !== 'active') throw new Error('Only active tasks may delegate work') const fields = { ...assignment, sessionId, taskId: task.id, createdAtSeq: task.createdAtSeq, requirementsRevision: task.requirementsRevision, delegationRevision: task.delegationRevision, taskGoal: task.goal, taskAcceptance: [...task.acceptance], workspace: task.workspace, sourceVersion: task.sourceVersion, constraints: task.requirements.map(item => item.text) } return { ...fields, binding: createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(fields)).digest('hex') } ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/core/delegation.ts:38-55](https://github.com/ArtlexYoung/dsh-super-code/blob/c9d50912df1e6624543481cb0d724ff3e18ef509/src/core/delegation.ts#L38-L55) 返回身份、状态及自报成本检查。
查看原文（18行） ```text /** Version matching is necessary for review, not proof that the work is correct. */ export function validateMemberResult(task: TaskMemory, sessionId: string, assignment: MemberAssignment, input: MemberResult): MemberReview { assignment = assignmentSchema.parse(assignment) const result = resultSchema.parse(input) const reasons: string[] = [] if (task.status !== 'active') reasons.push('parent task is not active') else { const current = createMemberBrief(task, sessionId, assignment) if (result.binding !== current.binding) reasons.push('stale task, requirements, workspace, source or assignment') } if (result.owner !== assignment.owner || result.attemptId !== assignment.attemptId) reasons.push('owner or attempt differs') if (result.outcome !== 'completed') reasons.push(result.outcome) const cost = result.cost const accounting: MemberAccounting = cost === undefined ? { kind: 'unavailable', budget: 'unknown' } : { kind: 'model-reported', budget: 'unknown', reportedBudget: cost.cachedTokens > cost.inputTokens || !Number.isSafeInteger(cost.inputTokens + cost.outputTokens) ? 'invalid' : !cost.complete ? 'incomplete' : cost.inputTokens + cost.outputTokens > assignment.maxTokens ? 'exceeded' : 'within' } return { reviewable: reasons.length === 0, reasons, accounting, result } ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行 DSH、模型、MCP 或基准测试 **影响**：不能确认效率、权限覆盖和实际账单 **进一步探讨**：固定宿主与任务，在隔离工作区验证委派、恢复及审批 ### Q03 · 严格删除保护是否覆盖一切删除及持久记忆？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、功能与机制 #### 完整回答 不是。拦截器仅在 strict 模式且工具为 bash 或 pwsh 且命令被识别为删除时申请单次批准；审批服务或代理缺失、异常或非 allowed-once 则拒绝。其他模式和未匹配执行路径不能因此视为被保护。任务记忆依赖宿主 session flush 成功才声称持久；两者均非本轮运行证明。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/dsh/deletion-protection.ts:58-71](https://github.com/ArtlexYoung/dsh-super-code/blob/c9d50912df1e6624543481cb0d724ff3e18ef509/src/dsh/deletion-protection.ts#L58-L71) strict 工具、命令匹配和审批失败关闭。
查看原文（14行） ```text owner.on('tools/execute', async (exec, next) => { if (modeFor(exec.agent) !== 'strict' || !['bash', 'pwsh'].includes(exec.name)) return next() const args = exec.arguments as { command?: unknown; workdir?: unknown } | null if (typeof args?.command !== 'string' || !deletionCommand(args.command, exec.name === 'pwsh')) return next() exec.signal.throwIfAborted() const approval = owner.get('approval') as Approver | undefined if (!approval || !exec.agent) throw new Error(corrective + '\n当前宿主无可用确认渠道，命令未执行。 No approval channel is available; nothing ran.') const reason = `删除保护：建议改用 trash。仅在本次操作是临时文件或构建产物清理时，确认以下命令的永久删除；其他文件请选择拒绝。\nDeletion protection: prefer trash. Approve permanent deletion only for temporary files or build artifacts in this exact call; reject other deletions.\n${typeof args.workdir === 'string' ? `工作目录 / Workdir: ${args.workdir}\n` : ''}${args.command}` let outcome: string try { outcome = await approval.request({ agent: exec.agent, toolName: exec.name, callId: exec.callId, reason, signal: exec.signal }) } catch { throw new Error(corrective + '\n确认渠道不可用，命令未执行。 Approval failed; nothing ran.') } exec.signal.throwIfAborted() if (outcome !== 'allowed-once') throw new Error(corrective + `\n确认结果 / Approval: ${outcome}`) return next() ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/task-memory-store.ts:17-29](https://github.com/ArtlexYoung/dsh-super-code/blob/c9d50912df1e6624543481cb0d724ff3e18ef509/src/task-memory-store.ts#L17-L29) 持久 checkpoint 失败抛错。

## 评测

### 评测方法

- **题集**：SWE-bench Pro hard-100，使用官方评分器。调优仅使用 SWE-bench dev 中筛选的 33 道困难题；hard-100 只用于评测冻结后的候选版本和排查问题，不参与调优，以避免对评测题过拟合。
- **对照**：官方标准预设，而非 minimal。旧宿主实测中，标准 + high 通过 51 题，minimal + high 通过 46 题，且标准每题 token 少 23.5%。与更强的对照比较，结论更严格。
- **控制变量**：同一宿主、同一模型、同一思考等级、同一预算，仅替换 Agent 预设。
- **指标**：通过数、每题净耗时（扣除失败请求和重试等待）、每题 token、每题模型调用次数。

### 评测过程

1. **旧宿主基线**（DSH `0.1.5-rc.2`，`deepseek-v4.1-flash`，high）：Super Code `0.3.0` 候选通过 56 题，官方标准预设 51 题，minimal 46 题。相对 minimal，耗时减少 47.6%，token 减少 44.9%。
2. **宿主升级后效果下降**：升级到 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 和 `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` 后，在默认预算下标准降至 46 题，Super Code `0.3.4` 降至 41 题，低于标准。排查发现新宿主收紧了上下文预算：压缩阈值由 800,000 降至 550,464 token，保留原文由 160,000 降至 98,560 token。
3. **恢复旧预算后复测**：双方均使用旧预算。标准仍为 46 题，token 增加 14.2%；Super Code `0.3.5` 提升至 49 题，token 仅增加 0.4%，净耗时减少 19.4%。据此，`0.3.6` 起插件默认使用旧预算。
4. **跨模型验证**（`glm-5.3-flash`，max）：Super Code `0.3.4` 通过 45 题，原生 ZCode 通过 29 题；Super Code 每题净耗时更少（32.9 vs 52.3 分钟），token 更多（550 万 vs 361 万）。

### 结果汇总

| 对比 | 通过 | 效率 |
|---|---|---|
| 新宿主、旧预算：Super Code `0.3.5` vs 标准 + high | 49 vs 46 | 净耗时 -21.3%，token -34.6%，模型调用 -25.5% |
| 新宿主、默认预算：Super Code `0.3.4` vs 标准 + high | 41 vs 46 | token -25.5%，净耗时 +13.9% |
| 旧宿主：Super Code `0.3.0` 候选 vs 标准 + high | 56 vs 51 | 原始耗时 -34.9%，token -27.9% |
| 旧宿主：Super Code `0.3.0` 候选 vs minimal + high | 56 vs 46 | 耗时 -47.6%，token -44.9% |
| GLM-5.3-flash：Super Code `0.3.4` vs 原生 ZCode | 45 vs 29 | 耗时 -37.1%，token +52.4% |

### 限制

- 每组配置只运行一轮。同一道题在不同轮次中结果可能不同，目前尚未估计固定配置下的随机波动。
- 默认预算与旧预算两组的插件版本不同（`0.3.4` → `0.3.5`），收益不能全部归因于预算。
- `0.3.6` ~ `0.3.9` 未重新运行 100 题评测。
- 跨模型对比是两套完整系统之间的比较，无法单独分离插件的贡献。

import { z } from 'zod'
import type { TaskMemory } from './task-memory.js'

export interface MemberAssignment {
  owner: string; attemptId: string; objective: string; ownedPaths: string[]; acceptance: string[]; maxTokens: number
}
export interface MemberBrief extends MemberAssignment {
  binding: string; sessionId: string; taskId: string; createdAtSeq: number; requirementsRevision: number; delegationRevision: number
  workspace: string; sourceVersion: string; constraints: string[]; taskGoal: string; taskAcceptance: string[]
}
export interface MemberResult {
  binding: string; owner: string; attemptId: string
  outcome: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled' | 'stop_unknown'
  summary: string; artifacts: string[]; checks: string[]; unknowns: string[]
  /** Optional self-report, never authenticated usage or budget enforcement. */
  cost?: { inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; cachedTokens: number; toolCalls: number; complete: boolean }
}
export type MemberAccounting = { kind: 'unavailable'; budget: 'unknown' }
  | { kind: 'model-reported'; budget: 'unknown'; reportedBudget: 'within' | 'exceeded' | 'incomplete' | 'invalid' }
export interface MemberReview { reviewable: boolean; reasons: string[]; accounting: MemberAccounting; result: MemberResult }
const text = z.string().trim().min(1).max(4000)
const count = z.number().int().nonnegative().safe()
const assignmentSchema: z.ZodType<MemberAssignment> = z.object({ owner: text, attemptId: text, objective: text, ownedPaths: z.array(text).max(64), acceptance: z.array(text).min(1).max(32), maxTokens: z.number().int().positive() }).strict()
const resultSchema: z.ZodType<MemberResult> = z.object({ binding: text, owner: text, attemptId: text, outcome: z.enum(['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'stop_unknown']), summary: text, artifacts: z.array(text).max(64), checks: z.array(text).max(64), unknowns: z.array(text).max(32), cost: z.object({ inputTokens: count, outputTokens: count, cachedTokens: count, toolCalls: count, complete: z.boolean() }).strict().optional() }).strict()

/** Compact, version-bound inputs for the existing host subagent provider. */
export function createMemberBrief(task: TaskMemory, sessionId: string, input: MemberAssignment): MemberBrief {
  const assignment = assignmentSchema.parse(input)
  if (sessionId.trim() === '') throw new Error('sessionId is required')
  if (task.status !== 'active') throw new Error('Only active tasks may delegate work')
  const fields = { ...assignment, sessionId, taskId: task.id, createdAtSeq: task.createdAtSeq, requirementsRevision: task.requirementsRevision,
    delegationRevision: task.delegationRevision, taskGoal: task.goal, taskAcceptance: [...task.acceptance],
    workspace: task.workspace, sourceVersion: task.sourceVersion, constraints: task.requirements.map(item => item.text) }
  return { ...fields, binding: createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(fields)).digest('hex') }
}

/** Version matching is necessary for review, not proof that the work is correct. */
export function validateMemberResult(task: TaskMemory, sessionId: string, assignment: MemberAssignment, input: MemberResult): MemberReview {
  assignment = assignmentSchema.parse(assignment)
  const result = resultSchema.parse(input)
  const reasons: string[] = []
  if (task.status !== 'active') reasons.push('parent task is not active')
  else {
    const current = createMemberBrief(task, sessionId, assignment)
    if (result.binding !== current.binding) reasons.push('stale task, requirements, workspace, source or assignment')
  }
  if (result.owner !== assignment.owner || result.attemptId !== assignment.attemptId) reasons.push('owner or attempt differs')
  if (result.outcome !== 'completed') reasons.push(result.outcome)
  const cost = result.cost
  const accounting: MemberAccounting = cost === undefined ? { kind: 'unavailable', budget: 'unknown' }
    : { kind: 'model-reported', budget: 'unknown', reportedBudget:
      cost.cachedTokens > cost.inputTokens || !Number.isSafeInteger(cost.inputTokens + cost.outputTokens) ? 'invalid'
        : !cost.complete ? 'incomplete' : cost.inputTokens + cost.outputTokens > assignment.maxTokens ? 'exceeded' : 'within' }
  return { reviewable: reasons.length === 0, reasons, accounting, result }
}

import { TASK_MEMORY_SOURCE } from './task-memory-projection.js'
import { foldTaskMemory, taskMemoryContext } from './core/task-memory.js'
import type { TaskMemoryEvent, TaskMemoryState } from './core/task-memory.js'

type MemoryChange = TaskMemoryEvent | { kind: 'unchanged'; id: string; revision: number }
export interface MemoryReceipt { id: string; revision?: number; eventSeq?: number; unchanged?: true }
export interface MemorySnapshot { state: TaskMemoryState; end: number }

/** One session write barrier, including recovery of an unconfirmed checkpoint. */
export class TaskMemoryStore {
  private readonly pending = new WeakSet<Session>()
  private readonly locks = new WeakMap<Session, Promise<unknown>>()

  constructor(private readonly ctx: Context, private readonly maxContextBytes: number) {}

  isPending(session: Session): boolean { return this.pending.has(session) }

  current(session: Session): TaskMemoryState {
    const state = this.ctx.sessionProjections.stateOf(session, 'superCodeTasks')
    if (state === undefined) throw new Error('super-code task projection is unavailable')
    return state
  }

  private async checkpoint(session: Session): Promise<void> {
    if (!await this.ctx.sessions.flush(session)) throw new Error('No host persistence checkpoint is configured; task memory is not durable')
    this.pending.delete(session)
  }

  private async access<T>(session: Session, signal: AbortSignal, run: () => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const previous = this.locks.get(session) ?? Promise.resolve()
    const operation = previous.catch(() => {}).then(async () => {
      signal.throwIfAborted()
      if (this.pending.has(session)) await this.checkpoint(session)
      signal.throwIfAborted()
      return run()
    })
    this.locks.set(session, operation)
    try { return await operation }
    finally { if (this.locks.get(session) === operation) this.locks.delete(session) }
  }

  /** Capture a confirmed immutable view; callers perform scans outside the barrier. */
  read(session: Session, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<MemorySnapshot> {
    return this.access(session, signal, () => ({ state: this.current(session), end: session.seq }))
  }

  write(session: Session, signal: AbortSignal, decide: (state: TaskMemoryState) => MemoryChange): Promise<MemoryReceipt> {
    return this.access(session, signal, async () => {
      const state = this.current(session)
      const change = decide(state)
      if (change.kind === 'unchanged') return { id: change.id, revision: change.revision, unchanged: true }
      const next = foldTaskMemory(state, change)
      // Every possible focus must fit, including room for future source identities.
      const preview = { ...next, recentSources: Array<number>(8).fill(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) }
      taskMemoryContext(preview, this.maxContextBytes)
      for (const id of Object.keys(next.tasks)) taskMemoryContext({ ...preview, focus: { kind: 'task', id } }, this.maxContextBytes)
      signal.throwIfAborted()
      const event = session.append('user/message', createUserMessage({ content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(change) }],
        source: { kind: TASK_MEMORY_SOURCE } }), { surfaceOp: 'append' })
      this.pending.add(session)
      await this.checkpoint(session)
      return { eventSeq: event.seq, ...(change.kind === 'focus' ? { id: change.id } : { id: change.task.id, revision: change.task.revision }) }
    })
